integrity: Analytical proof supplied, with finite independent numerical projections. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Positive integer layer sizes in an ordinal sum of antichains only.
Canonical shared-coordinate Euclidean Hausdorff distance, not an isometry-optimized or graph-path metric.
Numerical checks on finite cases corroborate but do not prove the all-size formulas.
Historical priority remains subject to independent literature audit.
title: Exact directed Hausdorff separation of layered order and chain polytopes
